items.title: 6.8 Hess ka heat summation ka qanoon (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 6.8, printed pages 126-130.

blocks.text: Thermodynamics ka pehla qanoon energy ki baqa (conservation of energy) ke qanoon ka izhar hai: energy na banayi ja sakti hai na mitayi, magar ek shakal se doosri mein badli ja sakti hai. Germain Henri Hess ne ise enthalpy tabdeeliyon par lagaya. Bohat si reactions ki enthalpy tabdeeliyan calorimetry se seedhe nahi napi ja saktin, misal ke taur par tetrachloromethane carbon aur chlorine se seedha nahi banaya ja sakta; Hess ka qanoon aisi enthalpy tabdeeliyan nikalne deta hai.

blocks.title: Hess ka qanoon
blocks.text: Kimiyai reaction mein kul enthalpy tabdeeli us raste se azad hai jis se reaction hoti hai, basharte ibtidai aur aakhri halaat ek jaise hon.

Hess ka qanoon enthalpy cycles se dikhaya jata hai, jinhen energy cycles ya Hess cycles bhi kehte hain. Farz karein A seedhe ek qadam mein B banta hai, direct route, ya do ya teen qadmon ke silsile mein, indirect routes 1 aur 2; raste mein banne wale products (M, N aur X, Y, Z) reaction intermediates hain. Phir route 1 ke liye delta Hr = delta H1 + delta H2, aur route 2 ke liye delta Hr = delta H3 + delta H4 + delta H5.

blocks.alt: Hess ka cycle. Baen surkh dabba A aur daen surkh dabba B ek mota surkh teer delta Hr (direct route) se jure hain. Oopar hare teer A se hare dabbe M + N (delta H1) aur phir B (delta H2) tak jate hain: indirect route 1. Neeche neele teer A se X (delta H3), X se Y + Z (delta H4) aur Y + Z se B (delta H5) tak: indirect route 2. Dashed teer teeno raston ki nishandehi karte hain.

Hess ke qanoon ke hal shuda istemalat: Sample 6.3
rows: delta H1 = delta H(C se CO2) - delta H2(CO se CO2) = -393.5 - (-283)

blocks.alt: CO ki formation ka Hess cycle: C + O2 seedha CO2 banata hai (delta H); doosra rasta C + O2 se CO + 1/2 O2 (delta H1) aur phir CO2 (delta H2) tak jata hai. Oopar aur neeche neele khamdar teer do raste dikhate hain.
blocks.caption: Sample Problem 6.3 ka Hess cycle (kitab ke safha 127 par chhape khaake ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ke is cycle mein beech wale khaane par ghalti se 'C + O2' chhapa hai. Asal mein darmiyani maddah CO + 1/2 O2 hai: pehle carbon CO banata hai (delta H1), phir CO jal kar CO2 banti hai (delta H2). Is liye delta H = delta H1 + delta H2, aur delta H1 = -393.5 - (-283) = -110.5 kJ fi mol.

blocks.caption: Hess ke qanoon ke hal shuda istemalat: Sample 6.4
rows: sum delta Hf(products) - sum delta Hf(reactants) = -109 - (52.2 - 92.3)

blocks.alt: Hess cycle: C2H4(g) + HCl(g) se C2H5Cl(g) (delta H). Neeche neele dabbe mein anasir (elements) 2C(s) + 2 1/2 H2(g) + 1/2 Cl2(g); is se teer oopar C2H4 (+52.2), HCl (-92.3) aur C2H5Cl (-109) tak jate hain. Neeli nuqta-dar lakeerein dabbe se C2H5Cl tak jati hain.
blocks.caption: Sample Problem 6.4 ka Hess cycle (kitab ke safha 127 par chhape khaake ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ke neeche wale dabbe mein '2C(s)' aur '2 1/2 H2(g)' ke darmiyan '+' chhoot gaya hai, aur 'HCl'/'Cl2' 'HCI'/'CI2' (bara I) chhape hain; yahan durust likha gaya hai. Neeche anasir hain; har teer us cheez ki enthalpy of formation hai jis tak woh jata hai. Is liye delta H = -109 - (52.2 + (-92.3)) = -68.9 kJ fi mol.

blocks.caption: Hess ke qanoon ke hal shuda istemalat: Sample 6.6

blocks.text: Hess ke qanoon ki ek khas soorat gas-phase reactions ki heat of reaction ka andaza bond energies se lagati hai. Pehle tamam reactant molecules ke bonds tor kar gas phase mein azad atoms banaye jate hain; enthalpy tabdeeli bond enthalpies (Table 6.1) ka majmooa hai. Phir atoms se product molecules bante hain, aur un ki bond enthalpies manfi (minus) nishan ke saath li jati hain kyunke bonds toot nahi rahe balke ban rahe hain. Aam taur par kisi bhi gaseous reaction ki heat of reaction ausat bond energies se Hess ke qanoon ki is shakal se nikalti hai: delta Hr = sum n ER - sum n EP.

blocks.alt: Tikon: 'Reactants' se 'Products' tak teer, surkh label delta H(o)rxn; 'Reactants' se neeche 'Atoms' tak teer E(R); 'Atoms' se oopar 'Products' tak teer E(P).
blocks.caption: Figure 6.4: Hess cycle; bond energies aur delta Hr = sum n ER - sum n EP ka taluq (kitab ki doosri Figure 6.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
Hess ke qanoon ke hal shuda istemalat: Sample 6.7
rows: -184 kJ, to delta Hf(HCl) = -92 kJ fi mol

blocks.alt: Energy-level diagram. Sab se oopar: 2 H & 2 Cl atoms (do neele aur do surkh gole). Baen darmiyani level: H2 & Cl2 molecules (neela H-H aur surkh Cl-Cl). Daen sab se neecha level: 2 HCl molecules. Surkh-surmai teer darmiyan se oopar: delta HR = +678 kJ. Oopar se sab se neeche tak surmai teer: delta HP = -862 kJ. Darmiyan se neeche mota kala teer: delta Hrxn = -184 kJ.
blocks.caption: Hess ka cycle; H2 + Cl2 se 2HCl ke liye bond energies aur delta H ka taluq (kitab ke safha 129 par Sample Problem 6.7 ke saath chhape khaake ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: (1) Sample 6.6 mein kitab ne propane ki term 'delta Hc (C3H8)' likhi hai aur O2 ki 'heat of combustion' ko sifar liya hai; dono jagah enthalpy of formation (delta Hf) murad hai: C3H8 ki delta Hf nikalni hai aur element O2 ki delta Hf sifar hai. (2) Sample 6.7 mein '436 + 242 = 478' chhapa hai; sahi jama 678 kJ hai, aur kitab aage 678 hi istemal karti hai. (3) Quick Check 6.4 'methane' ki enthalpy of formation poochta hai magar muadla 6C + 3H2 se C6H6 benzene ka deta hai; sawal benzene ka hai.

blocks.prompt: Combustion enthalpies -394 (C), -286 (H2) aur -3267 (C6H6) kJ fi mol se benzene ki standard enthalpy of formation, 6C(s) + 3H2(g) se C6H6(l), nikalein. Phir bond energies (N triple N 945, H-H 436, N-H 391) se N2 + 3H2 se 2NH3 ke liye delta H nikalein.
blocks.explanation: Benzene: delta Hf = 6(-394) + 3(-286) - (-3267) = -2364 - 858 + 3267 = +45 kJ fi mol, endothermic. Ammonia: torna 945 + 3 x 436 = 2253; banna 6 x 391 = 2346; delta H = 2253 - 2346 = -93 kJ fi mol muadla.

items: Hess ka qanoon (pehle qanoon se): kul enthalpy tabdeeli ek hi ibtidai aur aakhri halaton ke darmiyan raste se azad hai; Hess cycle mein kisi bhi indirect route ke qadam delta Hr tak jama hote hain.

Istemal: combustion data se formation (CO -110.5), formation data se reaction (C2H5Cl -68.9), napi hui hararat se formation (propane -104), aur azad atoms se bond energies se reaction (HCl -92 kJ fi mol).
